title: ReHome
description: Automatic Teleport for /home system on disconects/kicks etc.
body:
## ReHome

You know the problem: you're AFK on a server and get kicked - that's what auto-reauth mods are for, reconnecting you automatically.

But what if the **world just restarts** and you get teleported to spawn? Then you have to manually get back to your farm yourself.

**ReHome** solves exactly that: it remembers a location and automatically teleports you back once you drift away from it - using your own server's home system.

### How To Video:
https://youtu.be/Yi6OZRceIII

### How it works

1. Set a home at your AFK spot: `/sethome farm1`
2. Stand exactly there and type: `/rehome set farm1`
3. Enable monitoring: `/rehome on`

From now on, ReHome checks your position every second. If it drifts too far, `/home farm1` is sent automatically - without spamming the chat, since after the first attempt it only re-checks every 60 seconds until you're back home.

### Commands

- `/rehome on` - enable monitoring
- `/rehome off` - disable monitoring
- `/rehome set <name>` - set the home point (name = your server home)
- `/rehome distance <blocks>` - set the allowed deviation
- `/rehome distance` - shows the current setting

### Important

`/rehome set` reads your current position - so stand exactly on your home point before entering the command.

Purely client-side, no server installation required.
